parameters.description:
The status of the mapping differences by which to filter. 

Possible values:
ADDED — the field/value was added in the HubSpot configuration relative to the source CRM.
REMOVED — the field/value that is present in the source CRM is not mapped.
UPDATED — the field/value differs between the source CRM and HubSpot.

crmType.description: A string indicating the type of CRM system associated with the account.

id.description: The unique identifier for the transfer account, represented as an integer.

name.description: The name of the transfer account, represented as a string.

accountId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the account for which the transfer is being initiated.

phase.description: A string indicating the phase of the transfer, which is optional.

stages.description: An array of strings specifying the stages involved in the transfer process.

hubSpotLink.description: A link to the HubSpot system related to this transfer mapping.

id.description: The unique identifier for this transfer mapping.

record.description: A string representing the record associated with this transfer mapping.

sourceId.description: The identifier of the source record involved in the transfer.

targetId.description: The identifier of the target record involved in the transfer.

taskId.description: The identifier of the task associated with this transfer mapping.

thirdPartyLink.description: A link to the third-party system related to this transfer mapping.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account associated with the transfer.

completedAt.description: The date and time when the transfer was completed, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the transfer was created, in ISO 8601 format.

crmType.description: The type of CRM associated with the transfer.

id.description: The unique identifier for the transfer operation.

phase.description: The current phase of the transfer operation.

status.description: The current status of the transfer operation.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the transfer was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user who initiated the transfer.

configuration.description: An object containing additional configuration settings for the transfer. The structure of this object is not predefined and can include various properties.

dataType.description: A string indicating the type of data being transferred.

source.description: A string specifying the source from which the data is being transferred. "SAVED" if this reflects a value explicitly saved for this account, "DEFAULT" if it's computed on the fly and nothing has been saved for this data type yet.

dataType.description: A string representing the type of data being transferred.

description.description: A string providing a detailed explanation of the data type and its purpose within the transfer setting.

fields.description: An array of TransferSettingSchemaField objects, each defining specific attributes and requirements for the data type fields.

description.description: A string providing a description of the field.

fields.description: An array of nested TransferSettingSchemaField objects, allowing for hierarchical field definitions.

name.description: The name of the field, represented as a string.

required.description: A boolean indicating whether the field is mandatory.

type.description: The data type of the field, represented as a string.

writable.description: A boolean indicating whether the field can be modified.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this error was created, in ISO 8601 format.

error.description: A description of the error that caused the transfer to be skipped.

id.description: The unique identifier for this skipped error.

severity.description: The severity level of the error.

sourceId.description: The identifier of the source from which the data was being transferred.

taskId.description: The identifier of the task associated with this error.

thirdPartyLink.description: A link to a third-party resource related to this error, if available.

crmType.description: The type of CRM associated with this transfer stage. It is a string.

dependsOn.description: An array of stage IDs that this stage depends on, represented as strings.

id.description: The unique identifier for this transfer stage. It is a string.

phase.description: The phase of the transfer process that this stage belongs to. It is a string.

validationResults.description: An array of validation results for this stage, each represented by a StageValidationResult object.

taskIds.description: An array of strings, each representing a unique identifier for a task associated with the transfer.

transferId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the transfer associated with the tasks.

dataType.description: A string specifying the type of data involved in the transfer task when the error occurred.

message.description: A string containing a descriptive message about the error encountered during the transfer task.

stage.description: A string indicating the stage of the transfer process where the error occurred.

taskId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the task associated with the error.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the transfer task was created, in ISO 8601 format.

createdObjectsCount.description: The number of objects that were successfully created during the transfer task.

dataType.description: The type of data being transferred in this task.

id.description: The unique identifier for the transfer task.

phase.description: The phase of the transfer process that this task is part of.

skippedErrorsCount.description: The number of errors that were skipped during the transfer task.

stage.description: The current stage of the transfer task.

status.description: The current status of the transfer task.

taskErrorsCount.description: The number of errors encountered during the execution of the transfer task.
